referenceFunction.name: Photovoltaic cell, multi-Si, at plant

technology.text: Average production technology of photovoltaic cells from wafers.

timePeriod.text: Data investigated in 2004. Demand of electricity and metallisation paste updated for 2018.

representativeness.extrapolations: Data 2005 calculated from data 2004 by multiplying amounts of materials by solar cell area factor of 156*156/(125*125) = 1.56; energy scaled linearly with cell side length.
representativeness.productionVolume: Approximately 105000 MW for total c-Si in 2018
representativeness.samplingProcedure: Data collected from 5 specific processes and companies (4 multi-Si + 1 single-Si processing company).
